items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Pillarguri was – when Swedes invaded Norway, the Norwegian army had posted this woman to be a lookout.

ctx.x: That’s what that’s about. I knew that was a name of something, but – what does that mean, or what is it the name of?
Pillarguri was – when Swedes invaded Norway, the Norwegian army had posted this woman to be a lookout. This is where she stood, on top of this . . .
